question: You will see one image. Which of these is it most likely to be? (a) a frame from a top-budget film, a AAA game cinematic or a cinema nature documentary, (b) a stock photograph, (c) a seed catalog or textbook picture, (d) amateur generated art, (e) a real-time web 3D demo. Answer with one letter, a confidence from 0 to 100, and the one thing that most influenced your answer.

e, 92, the clean procedural 3D meshes and instanced spherical water droplets—especially on the ribbon-like grass blades, smooth cotyledons, and geometrically uniform striped seed shell—paired with heightmap soil and real-time post-process depth of field.

a — confidence 40. What influenced me most: it's clearly a CG render with film-quality lighting. It has a physically plausible backlit sunset, soft shadows, real depth of field with bokeh, and densely detailed soil, which looks like an offline path-traced render, not real-time web 3D or a photo. Against that, the simple, uniform geometry (smooth leaves, evenly spaced dew drops, a basic seed shell) means it could also be skilled hobbyist CG (d).

That looks like a single frame from a cinema-quality nature documentary sequence rather than a stock photo. (b) stock photo is the runner-up.
